mapper.select: SELECT ba.id, app_no, bie.institution_name, license_device_name, bie.unified_social_credit_code, bie.legal_person, bie.contact_person, bie.contact_phone, bie.ownership_nature, ba.create_time, bie.detailed_address, bie.region, bie.institution_level, bie.institution_type, b2.institution_name as superior_institution FROM biz_application ba LEFT JOIN biz_institution_ext bie on ba.institution_id = bie.dept_id INNER JOIN system_dept d1 ON bie.dept_id = d1.id LEFT JOIN biz_institution_ext b2 ON d1.parent_id = b2.dept_id WHERE ba.id = #{id} and ba.deleted = 0

SELECT ba.license_device_name, ladder_config_model, equipment_config_address, production_enterprise, specific_model, serial_number, installation_date, purchase_price, special_description FROM biz_application ba LEFT JOIN biz_class_a_equipment bce ON ba.equipment_id = bce.id where ba.deleted = 0 and ba.id = #{id}

SELECT initial_review_result, initial_review_opinion, b.nickname as initial_reviewer, initial_review_time, expert_review_result, expert_review_opinion, expert_review_time, expert_id, license_no, expert_attachments, license_generate_date
FROM biz_application a left join system_users b on a.initial_reviewer_id = b.id where a.id = #{id}

SELECT ba.id, bie.institution_name, ba.license_device_name, ba.ladder_config_model, ba.create_time, ba.app_status, ba.deadline, ba.app_type, ba.app_no, ba.institution_id, GREATEST(DATEDIFF(ba.deadline, NOW()), 0) AS remaining_days, blo.id as original_id, blo.license_no, bld.id as duplicate_id FROM biz_application ba LEFT JOIN biz_institution_ext bie ON ba.institution_id = bie.dept_id left join biz_license_original blo ON ba.id = blo.application_id LEFT JOIN biz_license_duplicate bld ON blo.id = bld.original_id where ba.deleted = 0 and ba.app_status = 5 and ba.creator = #{id}
SELECT license_device_name, b.institution_name, app_type, a.create_time FROM biz_application a LEFT JOIN biz_institution_ext b on a.institution_id = b.dept_id where a.app_status = 1 and a.deleted = 0
